name: clear-relay
description: Clears the session and carries on by itself when an answer ends with the line: safe to /clear; next: `<prompt>`. Waits 10 s, stops when you type or run /stay, and never retries.

enabled.title: Relay enabled
enabled.description: When off, the plugin never arms: an answer that ends with the handoff line changes nothing.

stateDir.title: State directory
stateDir.description: Where the relay's log goes, under clear-relay/<session>.jsonl. Empty uses ~/.local/state/amont-agent.
